description: Search postgres commits (code-history index), newest first, like git log: range (a rev, or A..B; default the newest release branch), message (regex, case-insensitive), author (regex over author, committer and Author/Co-authored-by/Reviewed-by trailers), paths, since/until (YYYY-MM-DD), changed_lines (a regex an added or removed line matches, as git log -G) and occurrences (a string whose count in a file changed, as git log -S).

author.description: Regex over author, committer and credit trailers

changed_lines.description: Regex an added or removed line matches (git log -G)

occurrences.description: String whose number of occurrences changed (git log -S)

range.description: A rev (its line back to the root) or A..B; default the newest release branch

repository.description: Repository; only postgres is in the code-history index for now (the default).

name: search_commits
